penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: A Salesforce OAuth token health monitoring service requires building and maintaining a persistent agent that polls multi-org token states, handles re-auth flows, and integrates with Salesforce Connected Apps — this is infrastructure engineering well beyond a Claude prompt plus page plus Stripe.

rationale: The pain is real and high-severity — production outages from silent bulk token expiration at paying B2B SaaS companies — and the buyer (integration engineer / CTO at a Salesforce ISV) is well-defined with budget authority. However, the solution requires a persistent, stateful monitoring service with Salesforce OAuth integration, multi-tenant token storage, and proactive alerting — none of which can be shipped as a simple Claude prompt plus landing page; buildability_with_ai scores 4, below the build gate floor of 6. Operational autonomy also scores 5, reflecting the ongoing infrastructure maintenance required.
solution_plan: This opportunity has strong pain and a clear B2B buyer, but the required product — a persistent multi-org OAuth token health monitor with Salesforce API integration — is genuine infrastructure software. It cannot be built by a non-technical operator using this Claude factory's standard tooling (prompts, forms, Stripe links). It would require API integrations, a persistent database of token states, and scheduled background jobs with Salesforce-specific OAuth logic. Youval cannot build or maintain this without a technical partner. Drop unless a simpler angle (e.g. a paid diagnostic guide or a one-time audit report delivered via Claude) is validated first.
notes: Fails buildability_with_ai build gate (scored 4, floor is 6). Fails operational_autonomy build gate (scored 5, floor is 7). Single forum signal (signal_strength: 2) — insufficient for validate stage even if build gates were met.
